Mount Jo, Copperas Pond, Mt Van Hoevenberg, Ausable Chasm or a boat day.

dayPlans.name: Young family: stay close to Wilmington
dayPlans.plan: Choose Cobble Lookout only if the children are comfortable with two-plus trail miles; otherwise skip the hike and start at the beach. Picnic, play and leave the afternoon flexible. High Falls Gorge is an alternative main outing, not an obligation.
dayPlans.rain: In heavy rain, switch to the Lake Placid indoor plan.

dayPlans.name: Rainy Lake Placid: one anchor, one extra
dayPlans.plan: Start with the Olympic Museum and lunch. Choose either a confirmed public skating session or Big Z's afterward. A movie is an optional evening plan if the film and showtime fit.
dayPlans.rain: For toddlers, shorten the museum portion and prioritize play or a library stop.

dayPlans.name: Couples' foliage loop: Jay, Keene and the lakes
dayPlans.plan: Wilmington → Jay Covered Bridge → Upper Jay / Sugar House Creamery when open → Keene → Cascade Lakes picnic area → Lake Placid → Wilmington. Walk only as far as desired at each stop. Save Whiteface Memorial Highway for a separate clear-weather window.
dayPlans.rain: On a Sunday in season, add the Keene Farmers' Market and drop another stop.

dayPlans.name: Saranac Lake: choose boats or a small mountain
dayPlans.who: Families with school-age children; active couples
dayPlans.plan: Make either a Swiss Marine boat rental or Baker Mountain the anchor. Add a village meal; younger children may enjoy a short carousel visit. Donnelly's is a seasonal treat add-on only after confirming it is open.
dayPlans.rain: Use Saranac Laboratory Museum or a scheduled Pendragon performance for adults in poor weather.

dayPlans.name: Fit hikers: a full mountain day
dayPlans.plan: Choose Cascade or Giant, not both. Check conditions, arrange legal parking, start early, carry essentials and agree a turnaround time. Plan a simple meal afterward rather than another paid attraction.
dayPlans.rain: Choose a lower, shorter outing when weather or the group's energy is not suitable.

dayPlans.name: Quiet couple's day without a summit
dayPlans.who: Couples; visitors who prefer scenery and culture
dayPlans.plan: Start with Heaven Hill or a short Mirror Lake stroll. Choose a gallery visit or a prebooked spa treatment. Finish with dinner and, when scheduled, a Pendragon performance. Golf-oriented guests can swap the morning for Lake Placid Club.
dayPlans.rain: These are alternatives to customize, not four required bookings.

alerts.note: Private land: weekday hiking only; weekend parking and hiking prohibited. Recheck DEC and posted signs before every recommendation.
Operator homepage says the park is closed for the summer and fall seasons; winter start dates inconsistent. Confirm directly before publishing a holiday visit.
Lake Placid Marina explicitly says it is not operating boat tours or rentals. Captain Marney's is the Lake Placid rental recommendation.
Use 56 Woodruff Street, Saranac Lake. Do not route guests to the former Brandy Brook location.
Working farms are not visitor attractions: no petting zoo, tour or animal-feeding promise for Asgaard or Sugar House.
House canoe, kayak and inflatables: confirm availability, condition, life jackets and sizes, capacity, pickup/return and permitted use before publishing operational details.
Lake Placid's emergency room closed in August 2023. Never direct a guest to Lake Placid for emergency care; the nearest 24-hour ER is Saranac Lake.
Map apps (AllTrails, Gaia, Strava) may still show the old Mount Jo routing; ADK is correcting it. Follow signs on the ground.

places.name: Salt of the Earth Bistro
places.review: The strongest all-around food-first recommendation in the area. It is tiny (nine tables), intimate and chef-driven, with global flavors layered onto familiar dishes. Service is personal and the menu changes enough to reward repeat visits.
